name: date-time
title: Date Time
description: The one Intl-based dates & times module — formatRelative, formatDuration, formatDate, formatDateTime, formatDateRange, formatTimeOfDay, formatDueLabel, groupByDay, and the tz cookie + getTimeZone server helper. Plain functions for server and client.

meta.whenToUse: Any date, time, duration, due label or day grouping shown as text — on the server, in route handlers, emails or client code.
meta.whenNotToUse: API/JSON output — keep ISO strings there.
